name: ImageMaid
description: ImageMaid is a script developed by the Kometa team. This tool is designed to help manage and clean up Plex directories by removing unused overlays, custom artwork, and clearing the PhotoTranscoder Directory. It also automates Plex maintenance tasks like emptying trash, cleaning bundles, and optimizing the database.

paths.name: Plex Config Directory
paths.description: Plex Config Directory containing the servers Metadata including Cache, Metadata, and Plug-in Support folders.

variables.name: Plex Config Directory (--plex)
variables.description: Can set the Plex Config Directory if its not mapped to /plex.

variables.name: Mode (--mode)
variables.description: How ImageMaid runs depends on the Mode Option that's currently set for that run.

variables.name: Plex URL (--url)
variables.description: Plex URL for downloading the Database from the Plex API.

variables.name: Plex Token (--token)
variables.description: Plex Token for downloading the Database from the Plex API.

variables.name: Use Local Database (--local)
variables.description: Use the local /plex directory to grab the database.

variables.name: Ignore Runnng (--ignore)
variables.description: Allows a run while the database is currently in use.

variables.name: Use Existing (--existing)
variables.description: Use previously downloaded or copied database can be used if it's less than 2 hours old.

variables.name: Empty Trash (--empty-trash)
variables.description: Also run the Empty Trash Plex Operation.

variables.name: Clean Bundles (--clean-bundles)
variables.description: Also run the Clean Bundles Plex Operation.

variables.name: Optimize DB (--optimize-db)
variables.description: Also run the Optimize DB Plex Operation.

variables.name: Overlays Only (--overlays-only)
variables.description: Will only remove Kometa Overlay Images and other images will be ignored.

variables.name: Discord URL (--discord)
variables.description: Discord Webhook URL to send notifications to.

variables.name: Timeout (--timeout)
variables.description: Connection Timeout in seconds that's greater than 0.

variables.name: Sleep (--sleep)
variables.description: Sleep Timer between Empty Trash, Clean Bundles, and Optimize DB in seconds that's greater than 0.

variables.name: Log Requests (--log-requests)
variables.description: Run with every request and file action logged.
